I would like to work on this. from what I have researched, this seems to be a [bug](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/69504256/preferencedialog-in-preferenceactivity-target-fragment-must-implement-targetfr) in Android itself. as stated [here](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/181793702), we can override `PreferenceDialogFragmentCompat` & try to fix this issue, or can we can wrap `MainActivity#onCreate#super` on a try-catch block. What are your thoughts?
